newsitem.title: USA: Universal Fabricators files for IPO of 2.8 mln shr.
newsitem.headline: Universal Fabricators files for IPO of 2.8 mln shr.

text.p: Universal Fabricators Inc said Monday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission with respect to the initial public offering of 2.815 million shares of common stock of UNIFAB International Inc.
UNIFAB International has been organized in connection with the offering to become Universal Fabricators' parent.
The company said it is offering 1.1 million shares.
McDermott Inc, which is disposing of all of its interest in Universal Fabricators, is offering 1.715 million shares.
The company said it has also registered an additional 422,250 to cover over-allotments.
The shares will be sold through an underwriting group managed by Morgan Keegan & Co Inc and Stephens Inc.
